project_type: Self-hosted single-user CMDB: FastAPI (async SQLAlchemy 2.0 / asyncpg / Postgres 16) backend + React 18 + Vite 5 + AG Grid frontend, deployed via Podman Quadlet (rootless). No auth by design.
language: Python 3.11 (backend), TypeScript 5 / TSX (frontend), Bash (deploy scripts), YAML (CI), systemd units
build_system: Backend: pip + alembic (container entrypoint.sh runs `alembic upgrade head` + `python -m app.seed` on start). Frontend: npm; build = `tsc -b && vite build` (type errors FAIL the build). vite.config.ts is OUTSIDE the tsc -b project (tsconfig include is ['src'] only), so vite.config.ts is NOT type-checked by tsc -b.
test_framework: Backend: pytest + pytest-asyncio (auto mode) against a REAL Postgres `vfcmdb_test`; endpoint tests use httpx.ASGITransport(app=app) with an AsyncClient fixture (see backend/tests/test_automation_endpoints.py); conftest.py drops+recreates schema from ORM metadata each test and forces all external integrations unconfigured. Frontend: Vitest 2.1.9 + happy-dom, setup frontend/src/test/setup.ts.
build_command: Frontend: `cd /Volumes/development/vf-cmdb/frontend && npm install && npm run build`. Backend import check: `cd /Volumes/development/vf-cmdb/backend && python -c "from app.main import app"`.
test_command: Backend (from /Volumes/development/vf-cmdb/backend, KILL stray pytest first via `ps aux|grep pytest|grep -v grep`): `POSTGRES_HOST=127.0.0.1 POSTGRES_PORT=55432 POSTGRES_USER=vfcmdb POSTGRES_PASSWORD=vfcmdb POSTGRES_DB=vfcmdb_test .venv/bin/pytest -q` (MUST be vfcmdb_test, never vfcmdb; ~4 min). Frontend: `cd /Volumes/development/vf-cmdb/frontend && npx vitest run` (single-run only, never a watcher).
verification_instructions: 1) For backend changes: run the backend pytest command above and confirm green (full suite). 2) For frontend changes: `npm run build` (tsc -b + vite build must pass) then `npx vitest run`. 3) For deploy scripts: `bash -n <script>` and, if available, shellcheck. 4) For CI YAML: `python -c "import yaml;yaml.safe_load(open(f))"` for each workflow (do NOT publish). 5) For JSON hooks: `python -c "import json;json.load(open(f))"`. 6) After editing backend/** or frontend/**: `./cbindex build` from repo root. Do NOT rely on the live dev Postgres `vf_cmdb_dev` (schema 0043, incompatible with HEAD 0037); use vfcmdb_test which conftest.py manages independently. Podman CLI at /opt/homebrew/bin/podman.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The semantic codebase index under tools/codebase_index/ is regenerated by `./cbindex build` after editing backend/** or frontend/**. No other generated/checked-in artifacts.
environment_constraints: Work on `master` directly, NO worktree. NEVER `git push`, force-push, or rebase pushed commits. The backend container NEVER calls podman/systemctl (container/host boundary is a file marker + a host systemd .path unit). All GitHub/ghcr network lookups must be SILENT on failure (bounded timeout, caught, degrade to 'no update info'; no crash, no badge). The migration-cannot-be-rolled-back caveat must be stated at code + script + docs layers (pre-update DB backup via deploy/scripts/vf-cmdb-backup.sh is the only true rollback). Alembic head stays 0037_physical_asset_theme_names — this feature adds NO migration.
contribution_requirements: Conventional Commits (feat/fix/docs/refactor/ci/chore). Only commit when done per-task; do NOT push. Hard rules: no auth anywhere; no credentials in the DB; writes stay on the generic CRUD path; Podman/Quadlet only (never Docker/compose-as-primary); kebab-case API slugs, snake_case DB columns, camelCase frontend identifiers. The three memory artifacts (SESSION_STATE.md current-state, MEMORY_BANK.md hard rules, AGENT_ONBOARDING.md) plus BACKLOG.md are the prose memory; update SESSION_STATE.md on finalize.
key_patterns: Backend: FastAPI router registration order matters — special.router is registered BEFORE the generic /{resource}/{item_id} catch-all in main.py, so concrete /meta/* and /admin/* paths must live in special.py to win. api_prefix='/api/v1'. GitHub lookup is cached (10-min TTL) and anonymous; is_newer is a pure strictly-newer semver compare (^v?(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)). Status-file contract is camelCase: {state,message,requestedVersion,startedAt,finishedAt} — identical keys in the Python _read_status default and the Bash write_status (jq -n write-then-mv, atomic). Frontend: typed fetch client frontend/src/api.ts uses a shared handle(res) (throws on !res.ok) and an `export const api = {...}` object with BASE='/api/v1'; nginx proxies /api/ -> backend:8000 (does NOT proxy /health) so the version endpoint MUST be under /api/v1. QueryClientProvider in main.tsx wraps the whole shell incl. the Layout footer, so a useQuery in the footer is safe. Vite build-time version is exposed via `define` as __APP_VERSION__/__APP_GIT_SHA__ (declared in src/vite-env.d.ts); the authoritative running/update answer comes from the backend endpoint.

key_findings_baked_in: Finding 1: expose version via Vite `define` only; do NOT touch any tsconfig for vite.config.ts (it is outside tsc -b; resolveJsonModule already set for src/**). Add `define` + `import pkg` ALONGSIDE preserved plugins/server/test blocks.

Finding 2: host state dir (default ~/vf-cmdb/state, VF_UPDATE_DIR) MUST pre-exist before the backend container starts (bind-mount) AND before enabling vf-cmdb-update.path. Document: mkdir -p ~/vf-cmdb/state; systemctl --user daemon-reload; systemctl --user enable --now vf-cmdb-update.path. The oneshot .service has NO [Install].

Finding 3: systemd .path PathChanged drops a second click during an in-flight run; document the dropped-click behavior; frontend disables/greys 'Update now' while state==='running'; no self-retrigger loop.

Finding 4: POST returns 'requested' (status file may be absent); until the script's first write_status running, GET returns 'idle'. Frontend treats 'requested' + a transient idle/absent window right after POST as 'still starting', NOT 'failed' — with a Vitest test.
Finding 5: release.yml must not move GitHub 'latest' backward; document 'only dispatch/tag a version >= current latest'; tag-push (v*) primary, workflow_dispatch fallback.
